text.card: A red giant 4,101 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.10 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,730 K at its surface.
